context: Tenant canvass at the hotel on 29th (Act 3).

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Tenants' petition. The march is the twenty-third. Will you sign?

lines.speaker: npc.sro_resident
lines.text: They turned off our hot water in June. It's August. Yes, I'll sign.

lines.speaker: npc.sro_resident
lines.text: My neighbor took the money and a bus ticket. Sign for him too?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Thank you. Bring a chair on the twenty-third.
